title: New-Year Resolution Progress Board
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=countdown:event category=resolution
| stats latest(progress_pct) as progress, latest(target_date) as target by resolution
| eval days_left=round((target-now())/86400,0)
| sort progress
description: Tracks progress on your New Year resolutions against their deadlines, keeping January's promises alive in June.
value: Most resolutions fade by February; a visible progress board is exactly the accountability that keeps them going.
implementation: Log resolution progress into `index=personal`; review percentage complete and days remaining.
visualization: Bar chart of resolution progress with deadlines.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how your New Year resolutions are going, keeping January's promises alive all year.
